mappings.parent_claim_text: The frozen algorithmic literature separates normal forms, oriented conjugacy, root extraction, finite-list decisions, serialization, and prefix completeness but does not bind SG2OwnerCanonical-v1 to the marked genus-two presentation.

Conditional on a future self-contained derivation of the displayed owner factors, positive content d greater than one and zero content define the shortest adverse local-factor theorem targets; the frozen literature does not itself prove those project-specific factors.

The proof program is falsification-first: derive and test the higher-content and zero-content local factors before investing in formal or compact-uniform recovery of any surviving content-one subproduct.
A content-one analytic subproduct is a contingent secondary endpoint and cannot replace full-owner recovery, imply an infinite scalar specialization, or migrate to the residual inverse-limit object.
The formal coefficient object R_+, its localizations and projections, and the separate zero-content Hahn object remain self-contained construction obligations because CP-P32-004 is unresolved.

Only after local-factor survival would an analytic branch require an absolute logarithmic-summand bound uniform on each frozen compact set and compatible with every specified iterated and diagonal limit order.
The controlling schedules remain N_k=k!, m_k=2^k, and N'_k=2(k!) for every k at least one, while the registered finite prefixes remain unexecuted diagnostics with no limit evidentiary force.

Phase-6 revision concerns only the pure homology-cover calibrator and changes no scientific recovery status, arithmetic A0 status, formal Route-A tuple, positive arithmetic A2 status, Route-B status, or canonical manuscript result.
